icbm_port:sulfur_dust.why: Dropped by creepers and blazes, with no ore or recipe. Coal or charcoal, sulfur and saltpeter craft three gunpowder, so sulfur must be worth at least three gunpowder or that recipe would create EMC.

icbm_port:radioactive_stone.why: Nuclear fallout turns stone into radioactive stone, which can decay back; valued like the stone it replaced.

icbm_port:radioactive_dirt.why: Nuclear fallout turns dirt into radioactive dirt, which can decay back; valued like the dirt it replaced.

minecraft:wither_skeleton_skull.why: ProjectE 1.1.0 values other mob heads but not this one, so the nuclear tier could not resolve. Three skulls (with four soul sand) summon a Wither that drops one nether star, so a skull is worth a third of a nether star; anything cheaper would let transmuted skulls farm nether stars. Item Alchemy already has a value (16 in Tekxit's config), which is left alone.

processes.name: summon_wither
processes.why: Three wither skeleton skulls on four soul sand or soul soil summon a Wither, which drops one nether star. Not checked for Item Alchemy: Tekxit's own config values the skull at 16, which makes this a loop in the pack whatever ICBM ships.

mekanism.why: The atomic-alloy alternatives of the nuclear, antimatter and red matter explosives load only with Mekanism, and Mekanism fills the uranium tags the uranium nuclear recipe needs. Item Alchemy ships fixed values, so these tiers must already be worth no more than their cheapest Mekanism recipe; Mekanism also adds items to tags ICBM's ordinary recipes accept (sulfur dust in the battery's sulfur tag, its steel and other metals in the material tags), so those recipes are read with Mekanism's tags too and the cheaper result sets the value. Mekanism's items are priced at the values mods/mekanism ships.

notes: The nuclear, antimatter and red matter tiers are valued at the cheapest of their recipes, derived like every other explosive: crafting and burning one never gains EMC under any recipe, and transmuting one costs as much as its cheapest ingredients.

Their atomic-alloy recipes load only with Mekanism, and the uranium nuclear recipe only when a mod (Mekanism among them) fills the uranium tags. Item Alchemy uses the shipped values rather than recalculating them, so emc.py prices those alternatives with Mekanism's own shipped values (atomic alloy, uranium ingot) and takes the minimum over every recipe, including the alloy recipes a populated uranium tag switches off. Without Mekanism these tiers are therefore worth less than their nether-star and skull recipes cost to craft, which never gains EMC. A uranium provider other than Mekanism is not priced; ProjectE's live mapper still uses the cheaper recipe, and Item Alchemy stays loop-free unless the pack values that uranium below the alloy path.

The carrier, held-item and cluster loading recipes only move one cargo item into NBT and back, or turn bomblets into a launch manifest, so they create nothing; transmuting a loaded carrier or missile gives an empty one.
